role: Reads and writes chunks in the Anvil NBT format: writeChunkToNBT serializes sections, height map, biomes, entities, tile entities and pending ticks into a queue the file-IO thread writes to region files; readChunkFromNBT rebuilds a Chunk (sections, entities with riders, tile entities, scheduled ticks) from a region file or from a still-pending save.
scope_reason: A chunk unloaded and reloaded must come back with its blocks, entities, tile entities and pending ticks; checkpoints start from a saved world. The save-writing side is deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain; triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md). The read side is a real item (A1).

notes: loadChunk starts with an oracle hook, netherite.oracle.ChunkIO.loading(this, coord): a chunk still pending is read from a copy of its NBT, so the chunk built from it does not share arrays with the oracle writer's (lane/oracletick; it was ChunkIO.settle(), a wait for every queued write). Entity-reload fidelity (section order, constructor draws on reload, riders) is gated by the persist-* and play-reload recordings; which entity kinds round-trip through the store was not audited here. GPU note: region.c and sr_ensure_saved heap-allocate per chunk, but only at checkpoint start, outside the tick. Gates not re-run. saveChunk queues netherite.oracle.ChunkIO.detach(this, coord, nbt), a deep copy while the oracle runs (vanilla's NBT shares the live chunk's arrays, and the oracle's writer thread wrote later light into the file, lane/rerecaudit), which the oracle's writer writes in save order. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings). The Nether's and the End's saved chunks come through the snapshot (Snapshot.java writes the DIM-1 and DIM1 region chunks; snapshot.c hell_saved, end_saved), which lane A1 (2026-09-25) closed. checkedReadChunkFromNBT's missing-Level and relocation branches answer only a corrupt or moved file, which a 1.7.10 save never has. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, persist-hanging-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour. A reloaded mob keeps its saved Dimension, runs its kind's constructor (the zombie's reinforcement nextDouble, creeper, spider, witch, silverfish) and counts toward the mob cap by its kind (sr_reload_living, sr_hell_adopt_reloaded); a reloaded animal keeps Age, InLove and dataWatcher 16; a reloaded item joins its chunk's lists; throwables and fireballs are saved and reloaded like arrows (nether-fight-s1, endportal-ents-s1, pearl-dims-s1).
